0022600085.text: Both the Atlanta Hawks and Orlando Magic open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Hawks on the road. Atlanta won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 130-101 victory in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Hawks a 45% chance to win. For Atlanta, Henri Veesaar is out with a knee injury and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture and is a game-time decision, while Izaiyah Nelson is out for Orlando after ankle surgery.
